run_pipeline_unconditional_generation: run the ScoreSdeVePipeline to generate unconditional images using a UNet2DModel and ScoreSdeVeScheduler
create_pipeline_with_unet_and_scheduler: create a ScoreSdeVePipeline instance by passing a UNet2DModel and ScoreSdeVeScheduler to the constructor
generate_images_with_batch_size: generate multiple images at once by setting the batch_size parameter when calling the pipeline
configure_inference_steps_and_sigmas: configure the number of inference steps and sigmas using the scheduler set_timesteps and set_sigmas methods
set_deterministic_generation_with_genera: set a torch.Generator for deterministic image generation by passing the generator parameter to the pipeline call
